--- a/src/content/docs/howtos/quick-start.mdx
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,166 +0,0 @@
----
-title: Quick Start
-description: Chart your first survey in 5 minutes. Transform overwhelming complexity into your first clear map.
-category: How-To Guides
-order: 2
----
-
-import Tip from "@/components/Tip.astro";
-
-# Chart Your **First Survey**
-
-Ready to navigate complexity into clarity? Get up and running with Notes Co in under 5 minutes! This guide will walk you through the essential steps to perform your first software analysis.
-
-## Prerequisites
-
-- A computer with internet access (Windows, macOS, or Linux)
-- **Docker installed and running** on your system ([Install Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/))
-- A Notes Co account:
-  - **Start your [30-day free trial](https://www.notes-co.example/get-started)**, or
-  - Contact our team at [notes-co.example](https://www.notes-co.example)
-
-## Step 1: Begin Your Journey
-
-1. **Start your free trial** at [notes-co.example/get-started](https://www.notes-co.example/get-started) or **contact our team** at [notes-co.example](https://www.notes-co.example) to establish your account
-2. Navigate to the dashboard at [https://dashboard.notes-co.example](https://dashboard.notes-co.example)
-3. Log in with your provided credentials
-4. A sample project with sample data will be pre-configured for you
-
-## Step 2: Get Your Notes Pass
-
-Your Notes Pass is the JWT token that authenticates your CLI requests:
-
-1. In the dashboard, navigate to your project settings
-2. Click **"Get your Notes Pass"**
-3. Copy or download the Notes Pass JWT token
-4. Save it somewhere secure (you'll need it for the CLI and API)
-
-## Step 3: Install the CLI
-
-Choose your platform:
-
-### macOS/Linux
-
-```bash
-curl -sSLf https://install.notes-co.example | bash
-```
-
-### Windows PowerShell
-
-```powershell
-irm -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://install.notes-co.example | iex
-```
-
-The installer will:
-
-- Download the latest Notes Co Survey CLI
-- Give you instructions to add it to your system PATH
-- Verify the installation
-
-## Step 4: Set Your Notes Pass
-
-Set your Notes Pass as an environment variable:
-
-### macOS/Linux
-
-```bash
-export NOTES_PASS="your-jwt-token-here"
-```
-
-### Windows PowerShell
-
-```powershell
-$env:NOTES_PASS="your-jwt-token-here"
-```
-
-## Step 5: Run Your First Survey
-
-Ready to see it in action? Choose your approach:
-
-### Option A: Use Our Sample Project (Recommended)
-
-```bash
-# Clone our sample project
-git clone https://github.com/notes-co/sample_project.git
-cd sample_project
-
-# Run your first survey
-notes survey inventory sample-project .
-```
-
-### Option B: Survey Your Own Project
-
-```bash
-# Navigate to your project directory
-cd /path/to/your/project
-
-# Chart your software landscape
-notes survey inventory your-project-name .
-```
-
-The **subject** (first argument) is required and groups surveys of the same system over time. Use a consistent name across runs to track how your project changes.
-
-The CLI will:
-
-1. **Survey** your software artifacts and generate encrypted **Artifact Dependency Graphs (ADGs)**
-2. **Upload** the encrypted ADGs to Notes Co
-
-## Step 6: View Results
-
-1. Return to the [Notes Co dashboard](https://dashboard.notes-co.example)
-2. Navigate to your project
-3. Reload the page
-4. You should see your survey results in the surveys list, including:
-
-- Discovered packages and dependencies
-- Vulnerability information
-
-## What's Next?
-
-Now that you've completed your first survey, explore these next steps:
-
-- [**CLI Installation Guide**](/docs/howtos/cli-installation): Learn about advanced installation options
-- [**GitHub Actions Integration**](/docs/howtos/github-actions): Automate surveys in your CI/CD pipeline
-- [**Image Surveys**](/docs/howtos/image-surveys): Survey a container image by name
-- [**Runtime Surveys**](/docs/howtos/runtime-surveys): Detect the cryptography your Java application uses at runtime
-
-## Common Issues
-
-**"Command not found: notes"**
-
-- Restart your terminal after installation
-- Make sure the installer completed successfully
-- Check that the path printed by the installer is in your PATH
-
-**"Authentication failed"**
-
-- Verify your `NOTES_PASS` environment variable is set correctly
-- Check that your Notes Pass hasn't expired in the dashboard
-- Ensure there are no extra spaces in your token
-
-**"No files found to survey"**
-
-- Make sure you're in the correct directory
-- Check that your input path exists and contains files
-- Verify file permissions allow the CLI to read them
-
-For more error messages and fixes, see [Troubleshooting](/docs/howtos/troubleshooting).
-
-## Get Help
-
-- 📖 **Documentation**: Browse our complete [how-to guides](/docs/howtos/)
-- 🎥 **Videos**: Watch our [video tutorials](/docs/videos)
-- 💬 **Community**: Join our [Matrix room](https://matrix.to/#/#notes-labs:matrix.org)
-- 📧 **Support**: Email [support@notes-co.example](mailto:support@notes-co.example)
-
----
-
-<Tip title="Success!">
-  You've successfully completed your first Notes Co survey. The more you chart, the deeper your
-  insights into your software landscape become.
-</Tip>
-
-<Tip type="info" title="What did we survey?">
-  The Survey CLI analyzed your software artifacts to generate encrypted **Artifact Dependency
-  Graphs (ADGs)**, then securely uploaded them to your private Notes Co environment.
-</Tip>
